verdict.rationale: The docs say Conductor's workflow, queue and schedule management is exposed over an OpenAPI-described HTTP API and the dbosctl CLI. They also say that API covers app registration and settings, search, cancel and fork, schedules, metrics, audit logs, and members, roles and API keys. That broadly mirrors the dashboard's actions, with the DBOSClient, the library CLI and an official MCP server adding further programmatic access. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of full UI/API parity (e.g. that dashboard pause/resume/restart-from-step are all exposed), a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at docs paths), and independent hands-on corroboration.
